# Termux-Vision Full Technical Specification (v1.5.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Zero-Dependency On-Device Computer Vision & Multimodal VLM Inference Engine with Pure Vulkan GPU (0.23ms) & ARM64 NEON (3.02ms) Acceleration for Android Termux
Provides 100% End-to-End Vulkan GPU Compute Canny Edge Detection (0.23ms), ultra-optimized ARM64 NEON C++ kernels (3.02ms), 5-stage classical filters, and on-device SmolVLM/Qwen2-VL Multimodal Vision-Language inference with Prebuilt-Asset-First idempotent installer.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-vision
- Command: pip install termux-vision
# or: termux-vision install
# or: npm install -g termux-vision
# or: bash <(curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uno-km/termux-vision/main/install.sh)
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-vision
